chatFlows.label: July spend spike
chatFlows.response:
July PO spend hit **$9.42M vs $8.11M in June — a $1.31M jump**, the highest month this fiscal year. Two POs explain nearly all of it.

{{chart:trend}}

- **AWS reserved-instance true-up: $862K** — the commit trued up in a single month instead of amortizing across Q3. One-time.
- **Salesforce renewal: $388K** — posted in July; last year it landed in August. Pure timing.

Strip those out and underlying spend was flat at roughly $8.2M — and August is tracking $8.21M, which confirms it. **This is a spike, not a new run-rate.**

> Recommended: tag both POs as one-time in the savings model so Q3 forecasting doesn't bake in a false baseline — Daniel Okafor's variance bridge already flags them on the finance side.

chatFlows.label: AWS EA brief
chatFlows.response:
Draft is ready — a one-page counter-proposal brief for Marcus, with the scenario model attached.

## The position
- **Usage**: $11.24M YTD, up 19% YoY — AWS is 12.2% of managed spend, our largest vendor by a wide margin.
- **Ask**: 3-year, $12.0M/yr commit at **14% discount** (currently 9%), plus $150K/yr in Graviton migration credits.
- **Walk-away**: 1-year at 12% — we do not sign a 3-year deal below 13%.
- **Leverage**: the $128,500 Databricks expansion is workload that could land on either cloud, and Microsoft has an Azure proposal on the table against our $6.48M relationship.

> Recommended: send before your 10:30 strategy session so Marcus and James Whitfield can pressure-test the walk-away number live.

chatFlows.label: Okta decision
chatFlows.response:
**Counter — do not accept.** Okta's $310,000 quote is 9.2% over the $284K budget and a 15.7% uplift on the $268K we paid in FY25.

1. **Price vs market**: $129/seat for 2,400 seats against a $114 market median — 13% rich.
2. **Runway**: the contract runs to Oct 15, so Mei-Ling has six weeks; no need to fold early.
3. **Leverage**: the June license cleanup cut us from 2,520 to 2,400 seats, and Microsoft Entra rides on the E5 estate we already pay for — a credible, cheap alternative.

**Counter at $288,000** (a 7.5% uplift) on a 2-year term with a 5% cap on year-two pricing. Okta has renewed at first counter twice before.

> Recommended: Mei-Ling sends the counter today; escalate to me only if Okta hasn't moved by Aug 20.
